notes.title: GALM 2025
notes.content:
[p]Games are great. We all know that. But did you know they can also be great for your head?[/p][p][/p][p]Running from [i]8–15 September[/i], to mark [b]World Suicide Prevention Day[/b], we’re proud to take part in [b]Games Against Living Miserably 2025[/b] - the event on Steam that celebrates how games can help us unwind, connect, and escape. It’s presented by Curve Games and the suicide prevention charity, Campaign Against Living Miserably. By taking part, we’ve pledged a donation to CALM’s life-saving work. [/p][p][/p][p]So, grab a game (or two) and play your part against suicide. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/GALM25"]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/GALM25[/url] 
[/p][p]Every wishlist means the world to us, so thank you for the love, the hype, and the quacks! - Stay Hydrated!  

You can also join our discord server and be part of the dev journey -> [url="https://discord.gg/QU2CZkbS"]https://discord.gg/QU2CZkbS[/url]

BornMonkie 🐵[/p]

notes.title: Debut Festival 2025
notes.content:
[p]Quack Quack Quacker![/p][p][/p][p][i]Dodo Duckie[/i] is finally out in the open with a shiny new [b]announcement trailer[/b]! 🎉🦆✨ [/p][p]And guess what? It’s not just special… it’s [b]eggstra special[/b]!

[b]Dodo Duckie is part of the “Debut Festival 2025” on Steam![/b][/p][p]🗓️ [b]August 7–11, 2025[/b] 

This showcase is all about celebrating the developers launching their very first games on Steam! and yup, we’re quacking proud to be among them! It’s an honor to be featured alongside so many delightful debut titles. 

Check out the full showcase and explore all the fantastic games:  [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/gmdv/sale/DebutFestival2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/gmdv/sale/DebutFestival2025[/url]
